# Retrieval Tools
The retrieval API exposes read_note, read_section, and search_notes.

## Read Note
Use read_note when the client needs complete markdown context.

## Read Section
Use read_section when the client needs one heading and its nested content.

## Search Notes
Search tools use full text search with BM25 ranking and path filters.
